descriptionMarkdown:
Upload explosive rockets, fuel cells and red ammo when building for faster readiness and send it to Aquilo. Once water level stabilizes, this ship can perform non-stop trips from Vulcanus to Aquilo and back without ever running low on necessities.

Needs the Flow Control mod (https://mods.factorio.com/mod/Flow%20Control?from=search)
title: Aquilo Ship
